in_marathi.name: Baijnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Baji
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baijnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baijnath is a compound name derived from 'Baj' and 'Nath'. Baj refers to Lord Vishnu in his form as Bala-Jestha, meaning the young one. Nath signifies a master or a lord. Therefore, Baijnath is considered a divine name for a boy, invoking blessings of Lord Vishnu.

Baj refers to Lord Vishnu in his form as Bala-Jestha, meaning the young one. Nath signifies a master or a lord.
